Package gnu.x11.keysym

Class Latin2

java.lang.Object
gnu.x11.keysym.Latin2
public class Latin2 extends Object
Latin 2-specific keyboard symbols. Imported from XK_LATIN2 section of /usr/include/X11/keysymdef.h. Note that byte 3 = 0x01.
